name: Acapulco
scopeLimits: Bounded city-source review only. No citywide completeness is claimed. At most three complete public parcel polygons are retained. No owner or address fields and no credentials or token values are retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official municipal portal identifies a Dirección de Catastro e Impuesto Predial and lists its local office/contact. The 2026 municipal revenue law describes prints of verified/cadastrally registered parcel locations through digital cartography and a separate planimetric restitution vector coverage for not-yet-verified urban parcels. This confirms municipal cadastral activity, not a public vector download.
technicalBlocker: No anonymous full-parcel feature service or vector schema was found in the official city materials inspected. The official Risk Atlas is a hazard/planning interface and its “predios” counts/layers do not establish cadastral parcel geometry.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the municipal digital cartography is available through an unlisted public service or only through paid/in-person print and cadastral procedures. No WUP point parcel response was obtained.

officialSources.observation: Official city page lists the Dirección de Catastro e Impuesto Predial and its downtown office/contact for balance questions and clarifications.

2026 municipal revenue law lists fees for printed locations of already verified/cadastrally registered urban parcels via digital cartography, plus a distinct planimetric restitution vector coverage for unverified parcels.
Guerrero municipal cadastral law establishes cadastral/parcel map registers and the fields that may be held in cadastral records; it is not a published city vector service.
Official interactive risk atlas contains hazard and planning layers with some parcel-related counts; it does not expose or establish a municipal cadastral parcel polygon layer.

viewerAndServiceTrace.notes: Reviewed city Risk Atlas and the official Catastro/Predial service and fee documentation. No cadastral parcel feature schema/API was exposed. The city homepage map links to a general city map, not a cadastral parcel download.
